selection.rule: Consecutive FLEX test numbers 1 through 31 inclusive, matching the first page of Table IX
selection.reviewMethod: Checked PSI rows against NASA Technical Publication Table IX for identifiers, fuels, numeric fields, missing markers and end categories

transforms.original: Preserve CSV cell text. Empty cells are stored as null.
transforms.value: Trim surrounding whitespace, map blanks and dash markers to null, and parse finite numeric values without scaling or rounding the source text.
transforms.locator: CSV rows and spreadsheet column letters start at 1. The header occupies row 1.
transforms.burning_rate: Use mm²/s from Table IX. The literal PSI CSV header is Burning rate; mm.
transforms.gas_labels: Use O₂, N₂, CO₂ and He species from Table IX. Keep mole fractions as fractions.
transforms.extinction_diameter: The reported quantity is droplet diameter at visible flame extinction. Appendix A.1 describes estimates for some tests. The selected PSI columns do not identify which individual values were estimated.
